title: Sprint-2 hardening: error envelope + backdoor namespace
description:
Close 3 non-blocking debts flagged by sprint-2 reviewers before main promotion:

1. Wrap resolveStatusVocab ambiguous-vocab throw in branch-setup main() try/catch so it emits the standard JSON error envelope (reason: vocab-error:ambiguous) + exit 6 instead of bubbling raw stack to stderr. Surfaced by TASK-009 architect-reviewer attempt-1.

2. Normalize ShardValidationError vs ShardLibraryError handling in branch-setup main(). Currently asymmetric: ShardValidationError is treated as soft (continue), ShardLibraryError as hard (exit). Both should be hard exits with envelope (validation = exit 6, IO = exit 6) for predictable operator UX. Surfaced by TASK-009 architect-reviewer attempt-1.

3. Rename BRANCH_SETUP_FORCE_INTERACTIVE env var to BRANCH_SETUP_TEST_FORCE_INTERACTIVE and gate on (NODE_ENV !== "production") to make the test-only intent explicit. Update the 1 test reference in tests/integration/branch-setup.test.mjs accordingly. Surfaced by TASK-011 security-auditor attempt-1.
acceptance_criteria: branch-setup.mjs main() catches resolveStatusVocab throw, emits JSON envelope with reason starting vocab-error: and exit code 6
ShardValidationError now causes exit 6 (matching ShardLibraryError); both paths emit JSON envelope with reason validation-error: or io-error: prefix respectively
Env var renamed to BRANCH_SETUP_TEST_FORCE_INTERACTIVE; production guard NODE_ENV !== production added; test file updated; comment block updated
Existing 116 tests still pass; add 2-3 new tests covering the envelope-on-vocab-throw path
notes: Reconciled: shipped 2026-05-01 (7541772) — shard flag was stale.
